reviews.text: I started using this every night and i can really see improvement on my skin, I dont use it when i use retinol, but i can see my pores getting smaller and my skin getting clearer. This is so so good i got reedle shot also for my scalp to help with my hair growth journey. Wil keep rebuying until i die.
reviews.zh: 我每晚都開始用，皮膚真係見到改善。我用 retinol 嗰陣就唔用呢款，但係我見到毛孔越嚟越細，皮膚亦越嚟越清透。呢款真係好好好，我仲為咗幫助我嘅生髮之旅，買咗 Reedle Shot 嚟搽喺頭皮上。我會一直買落去，買到我死為止。

reviews.text: Leaves my skin feeling so soft & plumpy the next day!! It also leaves a visible glow to my skin & I love that. I have sensitive combo type skin & I haven’t broken out once since I’ve started using it. I haven’t experienced any side effects either!! It feels like tingling on the skin when applied, after applying serums on top, you no longer feel anything & by the morning your skin will feel super soft and glossy. Soon I’d be incorporating it into my routine fully!!!
reviews.zh: 第二日皮膚就變得超級柔軟、飽滿！！佢仲令皮膚有明顯嘅光澤，我好鍾意呢一點。我嘅皮膚係敏感混合性，自從開始用咗之後，一次都冇爆過痘。我都冇試過任何副作用！！搽嗰陣會有刺麻嘅感覺，搽完精華之後，你就再感覺唔到，到咗朝早，皮膚就會感覺超級柔軟、水潤有光澤。好快我就會完全將佢加入我嘅護膚程序入面！！！

reviews.text: Second time buying ! Best thing ever for acne / post acne / irritations. Bought for myself and ma friend. Like more the 300 version because no need to remember to use it every day. But make the same effect in the end. Like to combine with the red version of the Reedle shot to erase the trace of post acne.
reviews.zh: 第二次買！對暗瘡、暗瘡印同激躁，係最好嘅產品。我買咗畀自己同朋友。我比較鍾意 300 版本，因為唔使記得每日都要用。不過最後效果都係一樣。我想同紅色版本嘅 Reedle Shot 一齊用，去消除暗瘡印嘅痕跡。

reviews.text:
Skin type: 28F, Olive tone, severely dry/moderately sensitive.

Love love love!! Used in cleansing routine 4 times a week: Cleansing oil -> Foaming cleanser -> VT Reedle shot -> retinol moisturizer -> snail mucin serum.

There is a minor prickly feeling that fades rather quickly. I would avoid the eyes as the skin is super sensitive and I dried myself out on accident the first time. Otherwise, it really helps my skin retain moisture for much longer periods - something that I have spent hundreds of dollars trying to find a product that'll work. I'm eager to see how it holds up in the dry winter months. My face texture and color has also improved a bit. Here are before and after photos under harsh fluorescent lighting.
reviews.zh:
膚質：28 歲女性，橄欖色調，嚴重乾燥／中度敏感。

好愛！好愛！好愛！！我每個星期用四次，放入我嘅潔面程序：潔面油 -> 泡沫潔面 -> VT Reedle shot -> retinol 保濕霜 -> snail mucin 精華。

會有少少輕微嘅刺痛感，而且好快就會消退。我會避開眼周，因為嗰度皮膚好敏感，我第一次唔小心將眼周弄到好乾。其他方面，佢真係幫我皮膚保留水分嘅時間長好多。呢樣嘢，我之前花咗幾百蚊去搵一款真係有效嘅產品。我好期待佢喺乾燥嘅冬季表現如何。我面嘅質感同膚色都有少少改善。以下係喺強烈熒光燈下拍嘅前後對比相。

reviews.text: Love the serum! It has a tingly sensation after you put it on and it feels like im giving my skin the care it needs. Not really sure about the calming effects or skin regeneration effects, but the feeling of taking care of my skin feels good. Doesn’t help with acne or sebum control imo.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款精華！塗咗之後會有刺麻嘅感覺，感覺好似畀咗我皮膚需要嘅護理咁。我唔係好肯定佢嘅舒緩效果或者皮膚再生效果，但係照顧皮膚嘅感覺幾好。依我睇，佢對暗瘡或者控油冇幫助。

reviews.text: It is fine. I don’t think it did anything to calm my skin down as drastically as other products on the market. I think all it did was sting my face. I did start getting small white pimples on my face so I had to stop using.
reviews.zh: 還好啦。我唔覺得佢有咁大效果去舒緩皮膚，好似市面上其他產品咁。我覺得佢所做嘅只係令我面刺痛。我開始喺面上長細粒白色暗瘡，所以唯有停咗唔用。

reviews.text: I’ve been using the VT reedle shot 100 and then 300 for a year now, since this new range has come out I’ve been really curious as I’ve noticed such great results over the past year; this cica version is so calming and not irritating at all. Leaves my skin feeling so smooth the next morning and I feel like it’s helped with my skin barrier too would recommend
reviews.zh: 我用 VT reedle shot 100，之後再用 300，已經用咗一年。自從呢個新系列推出之後，我一直好奇，因為過去一年我見到好好嘅效果；呢款 cica 版本好舒緩，完全唔會刺激。第二朝皮膚摸落好順滑，我覺得佢亦幫咗我嘅皮膚屏障，會推薦畀大家。

reviews.text: The lightweight formula absorbs quickly and feels soothing upon application. After a few uses, my skin looked clearer, and redness was significantly reduced. The added cica works wonders for healing and strengthening the skin barrier. Perfect for anyone dealing with sensitive or stressed skin!
reviews.zh: 質地輕盈，吸收好快，搽上去感覺好舒緩。用咗幾次之後，皮膚睇落更加清透，泛紅情況明顯減少咗。加入嘅 cica 對修復同加強皮膚屏障效果非常好。非常啱敏感或者受壓皮膚嘅人！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
